name: cypress-cucumber
description: This project is meant to be a kind of template to start working with Cucumber and Cypress

scripts.allure:history: mkdir -p allure-results/history && mv -f allure-report/history/* allure-results/history/ && rm -r allure-report || true
scripts.allure:report-history: npm run allure:history && npm run allure:report
scripts.allure:verify: if [ -d './allure-results' ]; then echo 'allure-results existe'; else echo 'allure-results no existe'; fi && if [ -d './allure-report' ]; then echo 'allure-report existe'; else echo 'allure-report no existe'; fi

author: Danny Barrientos
